title: Teach WTP skills to pass handoffs between queued workers
description: Update both skills/task-management/SKILL.md and skills/codex-wtp-loop/SKILL.md. Distinguish task comments used for audit/progress from handoffs used for cross-worker context. Teach global append for the next queued worker and task scope for known future work. In the loop, retain claim-attached task handoffs, read only the newest global handoff after claiming, inject both into the worker prompt, and require a concise global handoff before done or pause; have the dispatcher write one if worker failure prevents it. Document retention/purge without bloating the skills, keep imperative style/frontmatter valid, and run the skill-creator quick_validate.py against both folders.
